notablePrerequisites: Skullclamp attached to another creature you control.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Skullclamp attached, adding {C}{C}.
The creature dies, triggering Skullclamp, causing you to draw two cards.
Nadir Kraken triggers twice, causing you to pay {2} to put two +1/+1 counters on Nadir Kraken and create two 1/1 Tentacle creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Skullclamp by paying {1}, equipping it to a Tentacle token.
Repeat.
